chunks: And in the narration of Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ḥudhayfah ibn Manṣūr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"The month of Ramadan is thirty days and never decreases."

key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: Ramadan, the sacred month of fasting
key_terms.شَهْرُ: the month; a calendrical lunar month
key_terms.لَا يَنْقُصُ: does not decrease or become fewer

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about whether Ramadan can be less than thirty days?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the month of Ramadan is thirty days and does not fall short. It relates to the rulings of fasting and the determination of the duration of Ramadan in devotional practice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2040 - In a narration from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, from Abu Abdullah (as),
Imam (as) said:  "
The Month of Ramadan is thirty days and is never less."
